plan.notes: Official UNL 2025-2026 undergraduate catalog, Business Administration (BSBA) major page. The catalog publishes degree requirements with no official semester sequence, so this is a requirements-only plan. Non-business (15): ACE 3 calculus choice recorded at minimum (MATH 104, 3); ACE 4 science recorded at minimum 3 (range 3-5). Business Core (53): Purposeful Strategist 33 (11 courses x 3), Data Driven Decision Maker 7, Effective Communicator 9, Empowered Professional/PrEP 4. BSAD 50 recorded at 1 cr (derived: published section total 7 hrs minus SCMA 250 (3) and ECON 215 (3)); catalog publishes no standalone credit figure for BSAD 50. Catalog summary mentions SCMA 350 Business Analytics/Information Analysis with major-specific substitutions, but the detailed 2025-2026 section course lists total exactly 33+7+9+4=53 without it; excluded pending clarification. Business major (24): tailored 300/400-level business coursework; slots structured to satisfy the published distribution rules (min 3 hrs from five departments, min 6 hrs from three departments, min 9 hrs at 400 level across three departments). Experiential Learning requirement (0-credit co-curricular documentation) noted by catalog, no course code published. 60+ business hours required for BSBA; satisfied by core (53) + major (24).
